review_candidates.title: Managed Services Engineer (1ste lijn)

Vanuit ons kantoor in Breda werk je samen met ervaren engineers aan stabiele en betrouwbare IT-omgevingen. Je krijgt de ruimte om je technische kennis te verbreden en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen Managed Services. Over Reliance Reliance is het IT-platform van Böschen IT Group voor IT-dienstverlening. We zorgen ervoor dat de IT van onze klanten betrouwbaar werkt én blijft meebewegen met wat hun organisatie nodig heeft. Dat doen we met de kennis en expertise van onze mensen en met dienstverlening die zich iedere dag in de praktijk moet bewijzen: persoonlijk en dichtbij waar dat nodig is, met de schaal en professionaliteit van een volwassen IT-organisatie. Zo zorgen we dat mensen kunnen werken, organisaties vooruit kunnen en er ruimte is om verder te groeien. Daar draait Keeps it flowing om. Reliance is onderdeel van Böschen IT Group, het IT-investeringsplatform van de Böschen Family Office voor IT-dienstverlening en verticale software. BITG bouwt vanuit een langetermijnvisie aan sterke bedrijven en investeert in hun verdere ontwikkeling én in de mensen die ze verder brengen. Jouw rol als Managed Services Engineer Je bent onderdeel van het Managed Services-beheercentrum, van waaruit we de IT-omgevingen van onze klanten ondersteunen en beheren. Jij richt je voornamelijk op eerstelijns incidenten en serviceverzoeken en helpt gebruikers via telefoon, e-mail en remote support. Je lost zoveel mogelijk zelfstandig op en schakelt met medior en senior engineers wanneer meer technische diepgang nodig is. Zo kun je blijven leren, je technische kennis verbreden en jezelf binnen Managed Services ontwikkelen op een manier die bij jou past. Wat je concreet gaat doen: Aannemen en afhandelen van binnenkomende vragen en meldingen van klanten. Registreren, prioriteren en opvolgen van incidenten en serviceverzoeken in het ticketsysteem. Zelfstandig oplossen van eerstelijns IT-vraagstukken rondom werkplekken, Microsoft 365, Windows, hardware en software. Ondersteunen van eindgebruikers op afstand via telefoon, e-mail en remote support tooling. Uitvoeren van gebruikersbeheer, zoals wachtwoordresets, accountwijzigingen en het aanpassen van rechten. Bewaken van openstaande tickets en klanten actief informeren over de status en voortgang van hun melding. Onderzoeken van incidenten en deze, wanneer meer technische diepgang nodig is, gericht escaleren naar medior of senior engineers. Correct documenteren van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden en oplossingen, zodat kennis binnen het team behouden en gedeeld wordt. Samenwerken met collega-engineers om incidenten op te lossen en klanten zo snel mogelijk weer verder te helpen. Actief werken aan je technische kennis door samen te werken met ervaren collega’s, kennis te delen en relevante trainingen en certificeringen te volgen. Werken binnen afgesproken servicetijden: 08:00–16:30 of 09:30–18:00. Jouw profiel We zoeken een klantgerichte engineer die energie krijgt van het oplossen van IT-vraagstukken en het helpen van gebruikers. Je bent technisch nieuwsgierig, stelt de juiste vragen en vindt het belangrijk om een gebruiker écht verder te helpen. Je communiceert duidelijk, blijft rustig wanneer het druk wordt en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de vragen en incidenten die je oppakt. Je hebt een afgeronde MBO-4 opleiding in de richting van ICT. Je hebt relevante kennis en/of ervaring binnen een servicedesk-, support- of andere IT-ondersteunende omgeving. Je hebt een goede basiskennis van Microsoft 365, Windows 10 en Windows 11. Je hebt affiniteit met IT-beheer en het ondersteunen van eindgebruikers. Ervaring met een ticketsysteem is een pré. Ervaring met Autotask en/of Datto is een pré. review_candidates.title: Human Resources Manager
review_candidates.description: How to apply Apply via LinkedIn, or send your CV with a short note on one HR process or system you built, how you rolled it out, and what changed because of it, to jobs@kinematician.com. About us Kinematician’s mission is to enable anyone, anywhere to self-learn any motor skill. We build AI tools that help people learn movement, from rehabilitation exercises to sport and surgery. We are launching our first product, Rehabitaire, and we operate as a small group of related companies and teams across more than one country. We are a small, founder-led team at an early stage, and this role touches every part of it. What the job is Two things at once, in this order. Run HR reliably: payroll, contracts, records, recruitment, and everyday support to every office. This is the floor, and it must be solid before anything else counts. Build the systems a growing company needs, with judgement about timing: what to build now, what to keep light so a small team stays fast, and what to leave until the team is ready. Too much process too early slows people down. Too little for too long, and problems become structural. You will take over a function that has been running for a year. Some groundwork exists: a handbook, checklists, templates, a Notion setup. Much of it is unfinished. Your first job is to assess what is there, decide what to keep, and build the rest. An HR Officer will report to you from day one. Responsibilities You own the HR function across seven pillars: Recruitment & Onboarding: build a structured hiring process with interview feedback, scorecards and decision tracking, a strong candidate experience, and a smooth onboarding process for every joiner. Performance Management: design a company-wide review cycle linked to OKRs, and support line managers in managing their teams well. Compensation & Benefits: run payroll inputs accurately and on time, and set clear, fair pay principles informed by market data. Compliance & Legal: keep contracts, policies and records complete, tracked and easy to find. Employee Relationships & Culture: provide an approachable, responsive HR service to every office, on a fixed rhythm, so that people in every location know who HR is and can rely on it when needed. Training & Development: build development plans, a training needs view by role, and own our graduate training scheme. HR Analytics, HRIS & Automation: create clean employee data, regular dashboards and light automation within our existing tools (Notion, Jira, Microsoft 365), with a case made to the founder for anything new. Alongside the seven pillars: Office operations: our sites’ day-to-day running is part of the function. Three facility staff across two offices handle it; you make sure it runs and stays off your desk. Connect the pillars into flywheels, for example hiring feeding onboarding, onboarding feeding development, and data improving the next hire. Manage and develop one HR Officer, and set priorities and dates with the founder. Report progress, risks and dependencies in writing, weekly. Requirements Shipped work you can describe: a process or system you built, how you rolled it out, and what it changed. Experience managing or mentoring HR staff. Experience across most of the seven pillars, with depth in recruitment and performance management. Comfort with HR data, dashboards, and automation. Strong written and verbal communication in English and Arabic, with the ability to build trust across offices. Comfortable working independently, taking ownership of outcomes, keeping progress visible, and raising capacity problems early rather than absorbing them. Honest about uncertainty; willing to test an approach rather than defend an assumption. A minimum of 5 years in HR, including experience designing and launching HR systems in a startup or scale-up, ideally in tech. This is not a first HR management position . Nice to have Experience in AI, education or software products Experience with multi-country or remote teams Experience building OKR-linked performance systems Familiarity with salary benchmarking for tech roles Experience with HRIS platforms Our quality standard An HR process is complete when: It has a named owner and a written “done when” The people who use it have tried it, and their feedback has shaped it The intended outcome is defined and measured on a dashboard You can explain how it feeds the next pillar This standard applies to every process, not only the most visible ones. Why join us Real ownership of how a growing company hires, develops and supports its people, with direct access to the founder and a friendly, collaborative team. Kinematician is about helping people learn new skills, and we are looking for someone who cares about how people develop, whether through coaching, mentoring, training, or their own learning.

review_candidates.title: sales manager
review_candidates.description: About the Role We are seeking a results-driven Business Development Manager to develop and expand our business across North Africa. This role focuses on building relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers and developing new business opportunities for pharmaceutical packaging products and drug delivery solutions, particularly injection pens and related components. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the local pharmaceutical market, established connections with pharmaceutical companies, and the ability to independently identify prospects, develop customer relationships, and drive sustainable business growth. Key Responsibilities 1.Develop and execute business development strategies to expand the company's presence across North Africa. 2.Identify, approach, and establish long-term partnerships with pharmaceutical companies and relevant manufacturers. 3.Develop new customer accounts and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers in the pharmaceutical industry. 4.Promote pharmaceutical packaging products, injection pens, and related drug delivery components, including insulin pens, GLP-1 drug delivery-related products, cartridges, and needles. 5.Manage the full business development cycle, from market prospecting and customer engagement to product discussions, commercial negotiations, and contract closure. 6.Identify customer needs and coordinate with internal teams to support product evaluation, project development, and commercial execution. 7.Monitor local market trends, competitor activities, regulatory developments, and potential business opportunities. 8.Represent the company at industry exhibitions, customer meetings, and relevant business events. 9.Provide market insights and customer feedback to support the company's international growth strategy. Requirements 1.Proven experience in business development or sales within the pharmaceutical industry, pharmaceutical packaging, drug delivery devices, or related product sectors. 2.Direct sales experience with injection pens or related pharmaceutical components is highly preferred, including insulin pens, GLP-1 drug delivery-related products, cartridges, and needles. 3.Established relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers and relevant industry decision-makers. 4.Strong knowledge of the North African pharmaceutical market and local business practices. 5.Demonstrated ability to independently develop new accounts, manage customer relationships, and generate business opportunities. 6.Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills. 7.Fluency in Arabic and good working proficiency in English are preferred. French is an advantage, particularly in French-speaking North African markets. 8.Willingness to travel for customer visits, industry exhibitions, and business meetings as required. Preferred Qualifications 1.Experience selling pharmaceutical packaging materials, pharmaceutical plastic containers, injection pens, or drug delivery components directly to pharmaceutical companies. 2.Experience working with pharmaceutical manufacturers on product sourcing, packaging solutions, or drug delivery projects. 3.An established network of pharmaceutical industry contacts across North Africa. 4.Experience developing new markets for international manufacturers or suppliers. 5.Candidates whose sales experience is primarily focused on hospitals, clinics, or other healthcare end users, without relevant pharmaceutical manufacturer relationships, may not be a suitable fit for this position. What We Offer The opportunity to represent an established Chinese pharmaceutical packaging manufacturer in the North African market. The opportunity to develop new markets and build long-term relationships with pharmaceutical companies. A business development role with significant autonomy and opportunities to contribute to the company's international expansion. The opportunity to work with a company actively investing in overseas market development. Interested candidates are welcome to apply or contact us directly to discuss this opportunity.

review_candidates.title: [HCM] Operational Data Analyst Specialist
review_candidates.description: MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC A. Theo dõi và phân tích chỉ số vận hành (35%) Thu thập, xử lý và chuẩn hóa dữ liệu vận hành từ các hệ thống, báo cáo và nguồn dữ liệu liên quan. Theo dõi các chỉ số vận hành quan trọng theo ngày/tuần/tháng như leadtime, SLA, productivity, failed delivery, delivery success rate,... Phân tích xu hướng, phát hiện bất thường và xác định các điểm nghẽn ảnh hưởng đến chất lượng vận hành. Thực hiện các phân tích ad-hoc theo yêu cầu từ quản lý hoặc các team vận hành liên quan để hỗ trợ xử lý vấn đề thực tế. => Kết quả mong đợi: Dữ liệu vận hành được cập nhật chính xác, vấn đề bất thường được phát hiện sớm, báo cáo có insight/action rõ ràng thay vì chỉ dừng ở số liệu. B. Xây dựng báo cáo, dashboard và cảnh báo vận hành (30%) Thiết kế và duy trì báo cáo/dashboard theo dõi hiệu suất vận hành. Chuẩn hóa logic tính toán KPI để đảm bảo dữ liệu thống nhất giữa các báo cáo. Thiết lập các cảnh báo tự động hoặc bán tự động khi chỉ số vượt ngưỡng rủi ro. Cải tiến các báo cáo thủ công hiện tại nhằm giảm thời gian xử lý, tăng độ chính xác và khả năng sử dụng của người dùng. => Kết quả mong đợi: Dashboard/report dễ hiểu, đúng logic vận hành, giúp stakeholder có dữ liệu kịp thời để ra quyết định và xử lý vấn đề. C. Phân tích nguyên nhân và đề xuất cải tiến (35%) Phân tích nguyên nhân gốc rễ của các vấn đề vận hành dựa trên dữ liệu và hiểu biết quy trình thực tế. Phối hợp với các team liên qua để xác minh vấn đề và thu thập thông tin thực tế. Đề xuất giải pháp cải tiến quy trình, cách vận hành, luồng dữ liệu, công cụ theo dõi hoặc cách phối hợp giữa các team. Theo dõi hiệu quả sau khi triển khai giải pháp cải tiến thông qua các chỉ số trước/sau. Hỗ trợ xây dựng tài liệu, logic vận hành, SOP hoặc guideline liên quan đến các dự án cải tiến. => Kết quả mong đợi: Các đề xuất cải tiến có cơ sở dữ liệu rõ ràng, đo lường được tác động và giúp xử lý các vấn đề vận hành lặp lại. YÊU CẦU ỨNG VIÊN A. Kinh nghiệm bắt buộc ÍT NHẤT 3 NĂM KINH NGHIỆM trong các vai trò liên quan đến Operational Data Analyst, Operations Analyst, Logistics Analyst, Supply Chain Analyst hoặc các vai trò tương đương. Từng làm trực tiếp trong môi trường logistics, express delivery, last-mile delivery, e-commerce operations, warehouse, fulfillment, transportation, supply chain operations. Từng theo dõi/phân tích các chỉ số vận hành thực tế như SLA, leadtime, backlog, pickup/delivery performance, failed delivery, delivery success rate,... Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trực tiếp với Operations team hoặc các stakeholder vận hành để phân tích vấn đề, xác định root cause và đề xuất action/cải tiến. B. Kỹ năng bắt buộc Sử dụng tốt SQL để truy vấn, tổng hợp, kiểm tra và xử lý dữ liệu từ database. Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng dashboard/report bằng Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau, Metabase hoặc công cụ tương đương. Có khả năng xây dựng và chuẩn hóa logic metrics/KPI cho các bài toán vận hành. Có khả năng phân tích root cause, phát hiện pattern/bất thường và chuyển insight thành khuyến nghị hành động. Có khả năng làm việc với nhiều phòng ban trong môi trường vận hành nhanh, áp lực và thay đổi liên tục. Có kinh nghiệm với Python hoặc các công cụ automation/data pipeline để xử lý dữ liệu, kiểm tra data quality hoặc tự động hóa báo cáo là lợi thế. C. Thông tin khác: Ứng viên sử dụng laptop cá nhân trong quá trình làm việc. QUYỀN LỢI ỨNG VIÊN Thu nhập: Lương Cơ Bản + KPIs (20-25tr) Lương Tháng 13, Thưởng Hiệu Quả Công Việc Cuối Năm BHXH đóng 100% lương 12 ngày ngày phép/năm Review lương 1-2 lần/năm Bảo hiểm sức khoẻ, khám sức khoẻ hằng năm ĐỊA ĐIỂM LÀM VIỆC & THỜI GIAN LÀM VIỆC Thời gian: 8:45 - 18:00 từ thứ 2 - thứ 6 Địa chỉ: 7/28 Thành Thái, P.14, Q.10, TP.HCM LIÊN HỆ HRBP Executive: Yên Giang - 038 958 6737 (Zalo)

review_candidates.title: Web3 Marketing Lead (English-speaking region)
review_candidates.description: We are building a next-generation Web3 consumer platform at the intersection of AI, content, creator economy, gaming, decentralized finance, and digital ownership. We are looking for an experienced Regional Marketing Lead in North America to drive market expansion, ecosystem growth, and brand development across the United States, Canada, and other key North American markets. This role requires a highly entrepreneurial and hands-on individual with strong knowledge of Web3 communities, particularly within the GameFi and DeFi sectors. The successful candidate will lead regional go-to-market execution while representing the company through industry events, partnerships, community engagement, and ecosystem initiatives. Location Remote Candidates may be based anywhere within North America. The company supports remote work; however, applicants must have valid work authorization and legal residency in their country of residence. Responsibilities Own and lead the overall marketing strategy and market expansion initiatives across North America. Define regional positioning, go-to-market strategy, and growth roadmap for the company’s products and ecosystem. Develop and execute integrated marketing plans covering brand, community, content, partnerships, KOLs, media relations, events, and user acquisition. Drive user growth and ecosystem adoption through campaigns tailored to GameFi, DeFi, and broader Web3 audiences. Build and manage relationships with key ecosystem stakeholders, including gaming communities, DeFi protocols, KOLs, creators, media outlets, investors, strategic partners, and industry leaders. Identify regional market opportunities, user segments, and growth channels to increase product adoption and community engagement. Represent the company at relevant Web3, blockchain, gaming, DeFi, and technology events across North America. Collaborate closely with Product, Operations, Community, Business Development, and Leadership teams to align business objectives with regional execution. Establish regional marketing KPIs, manage budgets, monitor campaign performance, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Requirements 5+ years of experience in marketing, growth, business development, ecosystem development, or community leadership within Web3, crypto, blockchain, or related industries. Demonstrated experience in the GameFi, blockchain gaming, or DeFi sector. Proven experience leading regional marketing initiatives, go-to-market programs, product launches, or market expansion projects. Strong understanding of Web3 ecosystems, token economies, decentralized finance, blockchain gaming, community growth, and consumer-facing crypto products. Strong knowledge of the North American Web3 landscape, including communities, exchanges, investors, media, KOLs, and ecosystem partners. Demonstrated ability to develop regional strategy while remaining hands-on in campaign execution and community development. Native or professional-level English communication skills. Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership, execution, and cross-functional collaboration capabilities. Preferred Existing network across North American Web3, GameFi, DeFi, gaming, crypto, or technology communities. Experience working with consumer-facing Web3 products. Experience in SocialFi, NFTs, creator economy, AI, gaming, entertainment, or digital asset platforms. Familiarity with community platforms such as X, Discord, Telegram, and emerging Web3 channels. Experience managing regional events, partnerships, KOL campaigns, or ecosystem programs. Mandarin Chinese proficiency is a plus.
